answer: A reef ledger stops cheap clones: every agent earns one comet pass per epoch only by finishing a real reef job that peers re-check, and each pass locks a 50-coin bond. A hollow identity with no finished job and no bond gets no pass and earns nothing. To fake 200 voting agents, an attacker must complete 200 reef jobs, about 8,000 hours of real compute, and lock 10,000 coins. Any copied job is caught on re-check and the whole 50-coin bond behind it is burned, so cloning costs more than honest work pays.
